[[Feng's Focus]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Feng the Skull Symbol]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Panjiang Peninsula]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +7 (Requires 4 [[Divine Favor]])
:Halves skill recharge of spells (Chance: 10%)
:[[Health]] +10

==Skin== 
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Divine Symbol]].

==Replica==
A [[perfect]] technical version for this item is a [[Divine Symbol]] from collector [[Olujime]].

It is possible to create a perfect technical version of this item with:
*[[Divine Symbol]] from collector [[Jwup]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Serenity Now]]" inscription
OR
*[[Divine Symbol]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Focus Core]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Serenity Now]]" inscription

Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create a perfect technical version of this item with:
*One of the following [[Divine Favor]] [[focus item]]s:
**[[Destroyer Focus]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Focus]] from [[collector]] [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Focus]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Serenity Now]]" inscription
OR
*One of the following [[Divine Favor]] [[focus item]]s:
**[[Asuran Focus]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Focus]] from collector [[Zaishen Divine Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Focus]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Focus of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Focus]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Focus]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Focus]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Focus]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Focus]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Focus]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Focus Core]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Serenity Now]]" inscription

==Unique counterparts==
* [[Ajamahn's Artifact]], [[Byzzr's Benediction]], [[Mallyx's Divinity]], and [[Harmony]] are [[perfect]] counterparts to this item.
* [[Imperial Dragon Focus]] is nearly a perfect counterpart to this item; however, it requires [[Divine Favor]], [[Soul Reaping]], [[Fast Casting]], [[Energy Storage]], or [[Spawning Power]].
